behavior: A press that opens the popup of `Menu.Trigger`, `Select.Trigger` or `Combobox.Trigger` keeps the popup open when the release comes within 5 px of the point of the press. This is also true when the trigger moved. The trigger opens its popup in the frame after the press, and a layout change in that frame can move the trigger. The release of a press that did not move then lands on another element. Base UI closes the popup for that release with the reason `cancel-open`. A release more than 5 px from the point of the press, off the trigger and off the popup, still closes the popup.
